security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://bandcamp.com https://*.bcbits.com; img-src 'self' data: https://bandcamp.com https://*.bcbits.com; media-src 'self' https://bandcamp.com https://*.bcbits.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A focused Bandcamp desktop player with a real queue.
bundle.longDescription: Coda connects to Bandcamp's official Subsonic beta and gives your collection a fast, focused desktop listening experience with a persistent queue.
